title: lastrea filix-mas subvar. fibrillosa
intro: Lastrea filix-mas subvar. fibrillosa, commonly known as the Lady fern, is a subvariety of the Maidenhair fern (Lastrea filix-mas) that belongs to the family Blechnaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including the ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other minor health issues. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea filix-mas subvar. fibrillosa include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
